bio.lede: I build JavaScript products end to end — TypeScript and React on the frontend, Node.js and NestJS on the backend, AWS serverless in the cloud.
bio.p2: Nine years in, my work sits where architecture meets delivery: designing systems, setting code standards, reviewing pull requests — and writing production code myself. I lead technically rather than from a distance. Right now I’m Tech Lead on Burberry’s O2O clientelling platform at EPAM Systems.
bio.p3: Based in the Czech Republic, bilingual in English and Czech, and available for freelance and contract engagements.
